claims.text: Substituting a portion of Mo with Nb in as-cast HfMoTaTiZr will reduce the alloy density.
Partial Mo-to-Nb substitution will not significantly compromise room-temperature mechanical performance.
Partial Mo-to-Nb substitution will not significantly compromise high-temperature mechanical performance.
Nb is lighter than Mo and therefore replacing Mo with Nb can lower density.
The modified alloy will maintain a microstructure similar to that of as-cast HfMoTaTiZr.
The modified alloy will maintain a phase composition similar to that of as-cast HfMoTaTiZr.
Maintaining similar microstructure and phase composition will preserve the alloy's mechanical properties.
Grain size and phase composition are structural mediators of the response to Mo-to-Nb substitution.
The modified alloy will have at least 5% lower density than as-cast HfMoTaTiZr.
The modified alloy's room-temperature yield strength will remain above 1500 MPa.
The modified alloy's yield strength at 1000 °C will remain above 800 MPa.
The modified alloy's room-temperature fracture toughness will improve or remain comparable to the baseline.
As-cast HfMoTaTiZr has a density of 10.21 g cm−3.
As-cast HfMoTaTiZr has a room-temperature yield strength of about 1600 MPa.
As-cast HfMoTaTiZr has an elevated-temperature yield strength of 855 MPa.
Changes in microstructure or phase composition caused by Mo-to-Nb substitution could affect mechanical properties.

contradictions.description: The hypothesis acknowledges that an unknown substitution level must be optimized and proposes testing varying levels, but the rejection rule falsifies the hypothesis if any modified alloy misses a threshold. A deliberately low or otherwise non-optimal substitution level could therefore reject a hypothesis that only implies the existence of a suitable substitution level.

The experiment specifies uniaxial tensile tests yet states that those tests will evaluate fracture toughness. Fracture toughness normally requires a defined cracked-specimen fracture-mechanics test and loading geometry, which are not provided.
